summary: Route (a), a bespoke dependent quotient, is SELECTED and already verified: a 230-line prototype compiles sorry-free against the live tree with every instance the ShiftSet/SatisfiableBaseSet binder lists demand. Route (b) is a NO-GO on three independent grounds. Two premises of the brief were corrected by measurement: the instance burden is 5 instances (6 for Dense), not ~15, because AddCommGroup comes free from QuotientAddGroup when the quotient is taken by the eventually-zero AddSubgroup of the Pi group; and the Mathlib build the Germ/FilterProduct import triggers is 5 modules and 8 seconds, not a cost worth routing around.

artifacts.summary: Route selection with compiled evidence, the exact instance inventory, the route (b) no-go, and the measured Mathlib build cost.
Sorry-free prototype of the dependent ultraproduct carrier; three #print axioms probes all report [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

decisions_made: Route (a) selected: D* := (forall i, D i) quotient by the eventually-zero AddSubgroup, NOT a raw setoid quotient. QuotientAddGroup.Quotient.addCommGroup then supplies AddCommGroup with zero hand-written fields, and ShiftSet.lean already imports Mathlib.GroupTheory.QuotientGroup.Basic.

Exact hand-supplied list: AddSubgroup evZero (3 fields), LE, LinearOrder (5 fields, lt/min/max/compare defaulted), IsOrderedAddMonoid (1 field), Nontrivial, plus DenselyOrdered for the Dense branch only. Five support lemmas. Only le_total and one half of mk_lt_mk need phi to be an ultrafilter rather than a filter.

Route (b) NO-GO: (i) the only normalization theorem in the tree, intIso (DurationClassification.lean:252), is gated on SuccOrder + IsSuccArchimedean and so is Discrete-only; (ii) Discrete is exactly where compactness is refuted (DiscreteNonCompactness.lean:250); (iii) no common carrier exists class-wide, since SatisfiableBaseSet binds D : Type and Type contains ordered abelian groups of unbounded cardinality.

Task 475 supplies no reusable normalization machinery: TaskFrame.map / TaskModel.map / truthAt_map are all indexed by an isomorphism e : D ~=+o E, and comap is built from e.symm. Weakening to embeddings fails because WorldHistory.IsTotal would require constructing task-relation data at the new durations.

What 475 DOES supply is a template, not machinery: truthAt_map (IntTransfer.lean:254) is a completed six-case TruthAt induction with the box case at :283, and its two recorded tactic traps apply verbatim to the Los induction. Its box case is NOT a solution to R2, because it gets the forward direction free from invertibility of e.
Do not import Mathlib.Order.Filter.Germ / FilterProduct: Filter.Product carries only coeTC and Inhabited. Mathlib.Order.Filter.Ultrafilter.Basic (already built) supplies everything used.
R3 is discharged by elaboration, not assertion: shiftSetOnUD elaborates ShiftSet (UD phi D), which is only well-typed because the quotient stays in Type.

Left to S2 and named with anchors, not attempted here: the ultrafilter on the index type (Filter.atTop_neBot on the subset-preorder, then Ultrafilter.of), ShiftSet.sep on the ultraproduct (first-order, hence Los-preserved, but needs the same pointwise-choice extraction as the box case), and carrier_nonempty plus the valuation.
